  (ddd, ccc)
Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose first item is B. Start at (A, B): (A, B) is the first pair, its second item is A, so the next pair is the one whose first item is B: (B, C). Its second item is C, but C never appears as a first item - so C is the dangling end of the chain.
